mapper.select: SELECT sex AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM student GROUP BY sex
SELECT d.name AS name, COUNT(s.sid) AS value FROM department d LEFT JOIN clazz c ON d.did = c.did LEFT JOIN student s ON c.cid = s.cid GROUP BY d.did, d.name

SELECT CASE WHEN age < 20 THEN '20岁以下' WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20-29岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30-39岁' WHEN age >= 40 THEN '40岁以上' ELSE '未知' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM student GROUP BY CASE WHEN age < 20 THEN '20岁以下' WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20-29岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30-39岁' WHEN age >= 40 THEN '40岁以上' ELSE '未知' END ORDER BY MIN(age)
SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(s.sid) AS value FROM clazz c LEFT JOIN student s ON c.cid = s.cid GROUP BY c.cid, c.name
SELECT c.name AS name, ROUND(AVG(s.total), 1) AS value FROM score s LEFT JOIN course c ON s.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY s.course_id, c.name

SELECT CASE WHEN total >= 90 THEN '优秀' WHEN total >= 80 THEN '良好' WHEN total >= 60 THEN '及格' ELSE '不及格' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM score GROUP BY CASE WHEN total >= 90 THEN '优秀' WHEN total >= 80 THEN '良好' WHEN total >= 60 THEN '及格' ELSE '不及格' END
